title: Fix Spin the Wheel: enforce 20-minute cooldown and route points to Virtual Pet

requirements.summary: Display a disabled spin button with countdown timer (MM:SS) during the 20-minute cooldown period, and re-enable it automatically when the cooldown expires
acceptanceCriteria: The spin button is disabled and shows remaining cooldown time (e.g., '18:42 until next spin') when the cooldown is active.
The countdown ticks down in real time on the frontend.
The spin button becomes enabled automatically when the cooldown expires.
No other UI elements or pages are affected.

file_operations.description: Add cooldown state management and countdown display logic to the Spin the Wheel page. On mount and after each spin, call the backend's getRemainingSpinCooldown() to fetch the remaining cooldown time in seconds. If cooldown is active (> 0), disable the spin button and display a countdown timer in MM:SS format that ticks down every second using setInterval. When the countdown reaches zero, re-enable the spin button. Clear intervals on unmount and before starting new ones. Use existing React Query hooks from frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts to call the backend.

requirements.summary: After a spin that yields points, call only the Virtual Pet update mutation with the earned points, and do not call any other reward or score mutation
acceptanceCriteria: After winning points, the frontend calls the Virtual Pet update mutation with the earned points.
No other mutation (e.g., total score or generic rewards) is called for a points outcome.
The Virtual Pet on the Virtual Pet Hub page reflects the newly added points after a spin.

file_operations.description: Update the spin result handling logic to route points exclusively to the Virtual Pet. When the spin result returns points (pointsAdded > 0), use the backend's claimSpinReward(points) method which now internally updates the Virtual Pet's points. Remove any calls to saveCallerRewards or other score mutations for point outcomes. Ensure trophy outcomes continue to work as before. Use React Query's useMutation hook from frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts for the claimSpinReward call, and invalidate the 'virtualPetHub' query key after a successful spin to refresh the Virtual Pet data.
